nodes.meaning: An immutable Git commit selected from the current worktree HEAD first-parent history.
A path-level change between a commit and its first parent, or the empty tree for a true root.
An explicitly requested literal path set or a uniquely resolved project citation.
A bounded metadata projection of selected committed changes at an exact source snapshot.
Equality of the cache source binding and current worktree, branch, HEAD, history boundary, scope, schema, and limits.
An explicit request to atomically persist a derived recent view inside Git-private per-worktree storage.
